q.en: Change to passive: He writes a letter.
q.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যলৈ সলাওক: He writes a letter.

options.en: A letter is written by him.
options.as: A letter is written by him.

options.en: A letter was written by him.
options.as: A letter was written by him.

options.en: A letter is wrote by him.
options.as: A letter is wrote by him.

explanation.en: The object becomes the subject and the verb becomes is plus the past participle written.
explanation.as: কৰ্ম কৰ্তা হয় আৰু ক্ৰিয়া is আৰু অতীত কৃদন্ত written হয়।

q.en: Change to passive: She sang a song.
q.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যলৈ সলাওক: She sang a song.

options.en: A song is sung by her.
options.as: A song is sung by her.

options.en: A song was sung by her.
options.as: A song was sung by her.

options.en: A song was sang by her.
options.as: A song was sang by her.

explanation.en: The past tense becomes was with the past participle sung.
explanation.as: অতীত কাল was আৰু অতীত কৃদন্ত sung হয়।

q.en: Change to passive: They will finish the work.
q.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যলৈ সলাওক: They will finish the work.

options.en: The work will be finished by them.
options.as: The work will be finished by them.

options.en: The work will finished by them.
options.as: The work will finished by them.

options.en: The work is finished by them.
options.as: The work is finished by them.

options.en: The work was finished by them.
options.as: The work was finished by them.

explanation.en: With will the passive is will be plus the past participle.
explanation.as: Will ৰ সৈতে কৰ্মবাচ্য will be আৰু অতীত কৃদন্তৰে হয়।

q.en: Which sentence is in the passive voice?

explanation.en: In a passive sentence the subject receives the action.
explanation.as: কৰ্মবাচ্যৰ বাক্যত কৰ্তাই ক্ৰিয়া গ্ৰহণ কৰে।
